summary: VersaBank announced TSX approval for renewal of its Normal Course Issuer Bid (NCIB), permitting repurchase of up to 2,000,000 common shares, representing approximately 9.14% of its public float. Daily purchase limit is 25% of ADTV (6,627 shares), except block purchases. The NCIB runs from April 30, 2026 to April 29, 2027. Under the prior bid, 573,251 shares were bought at a volume-weighted average price of US$11.49. Management cites undervaluation and confidence in growth, including planned realignment to a standard US bank framework. What to watch: pace of repurchases and potential impact on share price and float reduction.
